steps.title: Know your models
steps.html:
Type each gray word in the Filter models box.

@MODELS@

This list is also on the Canvas tab in VR.

steps.title: Go on location
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Deserted in Filter environments. Click Deserted Isles, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the scene
steps.html:
Press the top button on your right controller, then click Models. Put the Green Sea Turtle and the Seagull on the sand. Plant the Fern behind them. Set the Shovel and the Binoculars nearby.

✋ Grab a model with the palm trigger. Use both palm triggers to make it bigger or smaller.
🗣 Say it out loud: “We protect this beach so the ___ can ___. Scientists check by ___.”

steps.title: Take the shot and send it
steps.html:
Stand back so the whole scene fits. Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Click Take photo.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Move the models, take a new photo and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Add one more animal the refuge protects: Star Fish

vr.full: Your photo shows the turtle and the gull, plus the Fern, the Shovel and the Binoculars.

studio.title: Count the evidence

labels.done: More nests after the beach was protected. That is evidence. Nice work, crew!
labels.start: Tap a circle. Is it a nest?
labels.flag: Drag a flag onto a nest, or just tap the nest.

studio.look: Two pictures of one beach. They are models, simple drawings with made-up numbers. A sea turtle nest is a sandy mound with two lines of tracks from the sea. Evidence is what you can see and count.
studio.do: Tap each nest to tag it, or drag a flag onto it. Count the nests in both pictures. Then pick what the numbers show.

scenes.title: Before the refuge
scenes.alt: Drawing of a beach with a hotel, a bright lamp, a beach chair, a sandcastle, footprints and two turtle nests
scenes.done: Before the refuge: 2 nests. Now count the beach after people protected it.

spots.msg: That is a beach chair. A nest is a mound with tracks from the sea.
That is a sandcastle. A nest is a mound with tracks from the sea.

scenes.title: After the refuge
scenes.alt: Drawing of the same beach with dune grass, a sign, a crab, driftwood and six turtle nests, and no hotel

spots.msg: That is a crab. A nest is a mound with tracks from the sea.
That is driftwood. A nest is a mound with tracks from the sea.

claim.name: My claim
claim.alt: Sea turtle nest on a sandy beach, marked off with wooden stakes and bright tape
claim.q: Which claim do your numbers support?

options.helped: 🐢 Protecting the beach helped. More turtles nested.
options.hurt: ⬇️ Protecting the beach hurt. Fewer turtles nested.

claim.miss: Look at your two counts again. Which number is bigger?

frames.starter: I think protecting the beach ___ because ___.
I saw ___ nests before and ___ nests after, so ___.

studio.full: You counted the nests in both pictures and picked the claim. Your 2 sentences have at least 20 words.

voice.brief: Welcome to the beach, crew. We film Scene 24, The Comeback. Show me how people protect a place for wildlife, then take the shot.
voice.step1: Before your headset goes on, meet your five models. Learn each gray search word. You will type it in VR.
voice.step2: Put on your headset. Click Explore, type Deserted, and pick Deserted Isles. Then click Begin Solo.
voice.step3: Set the turtle and the gull on the sand. Plant the fern behind them. Add the shovel and the binoculars. Then tell me why.
voice.extra: Got time? Add one more animal the refuge protects. That shot is just for VR crews.
voice.step4: Step back so the whole scene fits. Click Library, then Camera, and take the shot. Then send it to Canvas.
voice.step5: Press the Meta button and click Quit. Then open Canvas. Your photo should be waiting there.
voice.studio: No headset today? Come to the studio. Count the nests before and after. Then tell me what you think.
